['Henkel AG & Co. KGaA '].company_description: Henkel AG & Co. KGaA is a German multinational chemical and consumer goods company. It operates in two globally operating business units: Consumer Brands and Adhesive Technologies. Henkel is known for brands such as Loctite, Persil, Fa, Pritt, Dial, and Purex, among others. In the fiscal year 2022, Henkel reported sales of around 22 billion euros and an operating profit of 1.810 billion euros. The company has approximately 51,950 employees, with 85% working outside of Germany.

['Merck KGaA '].company_description: Merck KGaA is a German multinational science and technology company headquartered in Darmstadt. It operates in the areas of healthcare, life sciences, and electronics. The company has a presence in 66 countries and includes around 250 companies. Merck KGaA is the world's oldest operating chemical and pharmaceutical company and is listed on the DAX index. It has major research and development centers in Darmstadt, Boston, Tokyo, and Beijing. The company is known for its pioneering work in the commercial manufacture of morphine and its ownership of the Merck brand outside of the U.S. and Canada.
